summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing that, contingent on the Contingent Dividend Condition, the regular annual dividend rate on its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (STRC) will be 12.00% for record dates from November 1 through November 30, 2026, matching the definitive proxy statement for a Special Meeting filed October 5, 2026. The board declared daily cash dividends for each calendar day in that window, payable to holders of record at 5:00 p.m. New York time, with payments beginning November 2 and ending December 1, 2026. Management will recommend maintaining the 12.00% rate until STRC trades sustainably near $100. No transaction, stake, price, or advisor is disclosed; the item is a routine preferred dividend-rate notice, not a special situation, so the risk-arb angle is absent beyond watching the contingent condition and the referenced special meeting.
